bodyHtml:
MEGA-18 High-Pressure Booster Tank

18-Liter (4.5 Gallon) 16-Bar Pressure Tank for High-Rise & Long-Distance Water Systems | Aquasky MEGA-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

MEGA-18 is a pressurized water system component designed for high-rise buildings, fire systems, and demanding long-distance pressure support. With an 18-liter (4.5-gallon) capacity, it reliably maintains water pressure at a set, consistent level.

 

Built for high-stress environments, this tank supports a robust maximum operating pressure of 16 bar. To ensure stable performance and prevent fluctuations caused by temperature changes, it is factory pre-charged with 100% nitrogen gas.

 

Measuring 28.0 cm in diameter and 36.5 cm in height, this durable mid-sized tank is designed for point-of-use installations. It is an ideal solution for booster pump setups requiring exceptionally high-pressure performance and reliable flow.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The MEGA-18 is an 18-liter (4.5-gallon) high-performance diaphragm tank, engineered as the definitive solution for compact residential systems and thermal expansion protection. Utilizing a specialized FDA-grade polypropylene liner integrated with a premium butyl diaphragm, it ensures a dedicated "Safe Water Zone" by preventing any contact between the liquid and the tank’s metallic shell.

Key technical advantages include a 100% Nitrogen pre-charge and a 16-bar (232 PSI) pressure rating, which significantly outperforms standard industry tanks. This configuration ensures more stable pressure cycles and minimizes pump "short-cycling," directly preventing motor burnout and extending equipment lifespan. 

Constructed with a heavy-duty cold-rolled carbon steel shell and protected by a triple-grade epoxy powder finish, the MEGA-18 offers superior oxidation resistance. Equipped with a premium 304 Stainless Steel lead-free connector, this CE and ISO 9001 certified unit provides an energy-saving, maintenance-free solution for critical high-pressure applications.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • 16-Bar high-pressure rating for high-rise buildings and long-distance pipelines.
  • Cold rolled carbon steel shell offers exceptional structural integrity under extreme pressure.
  • 304 stainless steel connection ensures secure, rust-free, durable integration.
  • Heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm withstands frequent cycling and maintains constant pressure.
  • Triple-grade blue paint coating provides superior exterior protection.
  • 100% Nitrogen pre-charged to prevent pressure loss common with compressed air.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the MEGA-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

The MEGA-18 stores supplemental water between the liner and the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm. When a faucet is opened or an appliance demands water, the compressed nitrogen air chamber pushes the stored water into the system. This allows the system to meet low-volume water demands without immediately triggering the pump motor. By creating this efficient supply cycle, the tank minimizes pump cycling, stabilizes water pressure, and conserves energy.

Key benefits

  • Provides ideal high-pressure delivery for high-rise buildings and long-distance applications
  • Extends equipment life by reducing pump starts and preventing motor burnout
  • Guarantees robust, stable water flow for showers, washers, and dishwashers
  • Zero maintenance required, saving time and servicing costs

Typical Applications

  • High-rise building water supply networks
  • Long-distance water pressure support systems
  • Fire systems and water machining (3L per min flow rate applications)
  • Residential and commercial booster pump systems
  • Appliance water pressure stabilization (washing machines, dishwashers)

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : How big is the MEGA-18 and what is its flow rate?

The MEGA-18 is a compact 4.5-gallon (18-liter) tank that stands 14.4 inches tall. It provides reliable pressure support for residential and light commercial systems with a 3 liters per minute flow rate.
 

Q2 : Can the MEGA-18 be used safely for drinking water applications?

Yes, the MEGA-18 is completely safe for drinking water because it uses a polypropylene liner and a pure butyl rubber diaphragm (compliant with DIN 4807) to keep water from touching the metal shell. 
 

Q3 : What type of plumbing connection does MEGA-18 feature?

To safely handle 16-Bar high-pressure systems, it uses a 1-inch 304 Stainless Steel connector. This guarantees a highly durable, 100% rust-proof and lead-free seal.
